# TLDRGraph

TLDRGraph generates a source-backed feature catalog through a coding-agent file
handoff and renders it as a standalone Workflow Explorer.

- `tldrgraph init`: create and validate the workflow catalog.
- `tldrgraph refresh`: update an existing workflow catalog after source changes.
- `tldrgraph ui --serve`: explore workflows with live source evidence.
- `tldrgraph install`: install the agent workflow and contract.

Schemas and evidence rules are documented in `agents/contract-spec.md`.
